QuestInfo.name: Mysterious Girl
QuestInfo.0: According to Chief Stan, a scary ghost has been appearing on a path outside of town. You decide night time is the best time to go ghost hunting. Hopefully that isn't a mistake...
QuestInfo.1: According to Chief Stan, a scary ghost has been appearing on a path outside of town. You decide night time is the best time to go ghost hunting. Hopefully that isn't a mistake...
QuestInfo.2: You meet a strange girl loitering on a path outside of town. She says she loves adventure and wants to help you locate the ghost using her book of necromancy.
